_description: Rules for the PaySim mobile-money simulator (Lopez-Rojas et al., 2016). Use them to try Osprey on PaySim, not as evidence of quality on real traffic.
_note: Measured with cmd/qualitybench on all 6,362,620 PaySim rows, detection mode, sum scoring, threshold 0.7: 8,018 alerts, recall 97.6%, precision 100%. PaySim makes each fraud send the whole balance of the account, and paysim-whole-balance matches exactly that, so this result shows how the simulator works. Without paysim-whole-balance, no rule set we tried got more than 4% precision. See docs/STARTER_KIT.md.

rules.name: Whole Balance Sent
rules.description: The payment sends the exact balance of the account. Moving all available funds at once is a common account-takeover signal.
